_comment: Fallback topic names for EECS special subjects (numbers with an 'S' after the dot, e.g. 6.S062). `python3 scripts/fetch_special_subjects.py --term <term>` now imports live term-specific titles and descriptions from the official EECS Subject Updates feed, which wins over this map because special-subject numbers can be reused. Use this file only when an official term page has no matching entry. Keys are uppercased course IDs; values are topic titles.
